decisions: Doctor and run preflight query Copilot model ids with a 5-second timeout; this is the right place to reject account-incompatible ids before a session costs money.
The account's Copilot plan is shown and an absent/failed plan lookup is reported as unknown, never as an error; this is sound because the internal endpoint is not a public contract.

API reachability and login failures do not block config set or doctor, except models copilot itself; this preserves an unavailable network as a warning while still refusing authoritative missing/disabled answers.
config set --kinds accepts --agent, --model and --effort and writes all named kinds atomically after validation; the selected form is clearer than comma lists in positional keys.
The seven current session kinds and their existing agent/model/effort key triplets define the --kinds surface; no new keys are introduced.
models copilot prints the plan first, then model rows in strings ordering; the ordering is deterministic and appropriate.
